title: Crystal River Sunset Tours

services.name: Snook fishing
services.desc: The weather has been hot but the fishing has been even hotter! The Redfish spawn is upon us, bringing in large numbers of quality Redfish. Also the Mangrove Snapper bite has been great on the offshore rock piles. Below I will go over some tips you might find useful to take advantage of the wonderful fishing that Crystal River Florida has to offer in August. Although the hot weather can make redfish hard to catch in the heat of the day, it makes them fairly predictable this time of year. Getting out on the water early when it is cooler will pay off! services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: We offer one of a kind private sunset cruises out of the beautiful Crystal River! Our tour boat is spacious and will comfortably accommodate up to 6 passengers. Pickup is available at any dock or restaurant on the Crystal River. from there you will be guided on a scenic tour down the Crystal River and out into the Gulf Of Mexico to watch a gorgeous Crystal River sunset! Along the way you will have the opportunity to see all the wonderful wildlife that Crystal River has to offer including Dolphin, Bald Eagle, Osprey, Manatees and much more.
